inlineContent.text: This guide builds a campaigns screen for an advertising CRM step by step. The
same structure fits any list of records: customers, orders, invoices. The
pieces are:
a model decoded from the API;
column ids and the column definition in one place;
a data source that holds the records in display order and sorts them;
a view controller that owns the table, the data source and the controls
around the table.
Keep the values the table shows in the record, ready to return. Computed
metrics that depend only on the record, like ROI, are cheap as computed
properties:

code: enum Status: String, Decodable { case active, paused, finished }
var roi: Double { spend > 0 ? (revenue - spend) / spend : 0 }
var ctr: Double { impressions > 0 ? Double(clicks) / Double(impressions) : 0 }
